title: Context-Enhanced Video Moment Retrieval with Large Language Models

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: To tackle this issue, we propose a Large Language Model-guided Moment Retrieval (LMR) approach that employs the extensive knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve video context representation as well as cross-modal alignment, facilitating accurate localization of target moments.
